title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Fargate
description: Create an API Gateway endpoint to access an AWS Fargate service

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This project contains a sample AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) template for deploying an AWS Fargate service running on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) cluster with a private Application Load Balancer in-front. The Application Load Balanced Fargate Service is integrated with Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to expose the endpoint.

This template uses a custom image without having to pre-push the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) or another container library. This makes use of the in-built ecs.ContainerImage.fromAsset method. The custom image has a base route / to output a message.
